description.value: Cactus Club Cafe Coal Harbour is an upscale-casual chain restaurant perched at 1085 Canada Place with panoramic views of the Burrard Inlet and the North Shore mountains. The chef-driven international menu spans sushi, steaks, pastas, and handhelds alongside a full lounge and patio — making it a prominent stop along the Coal Harbour waterfront seawall. Private dining and large-group event spaces are available, and the venue hosts a daily happy hour.
